---
title: v2.2.5 — Release Content and Rust Validation Improvements
---

## Overview

This release aligns release metadata with published versions, strengthens release content checks, and brings Windows and macOS Rust validation onto the same workflow steps.

## Highlights

- Consolidate changes from skipped versions into the published v2.2.4 metadata and remove metadata files for versions that were never published.
- Require release titles to start with the current tag version and a meaningful summary, including titles resolved from pull request declarations or a single pull request fallback.
- Compare the published release title and notes with the validated content after publication, and document how to prepare metadata across skipped versions.
- Check historical metadata against published releases during PR validation and clarify that skipped-version summary coverage requires a source review.
- Share Rust validation setup, build, smoke, and activation steps across Windows and macOS, with matching CI tests.
- Remove redundant historical instruction fixtures and their fixture support code.
